text: Add a way for a person to review an introspection's class, so 'athena score-jev' can ever have labels: today it counts only introspections a reviewer labeled, and no command records a review. Add 'athena review <introspection-id>' that shows the record (what happened, class, cause, prevention, and Jev's shadow answer) and records the person's verdict in one step: the class is right, or the right class is another existing or new class, with an optional one-line note. Show the number of unreviewed introspections in 'athena status' so it is easy to keep up. A review is a record and never edits the introspection itself. Verify with fixture records in a temporary directory.
